description:
Verify that two independently signed records agree on one authorized,
completed action. $0.01 USDC via x402 per successful verification.
Does not independently prove real-world execution or key ownership.

acknowledgment.description: Separately signed executor acknowledgment binding the authorization digest
acknowledgment.title: Acknowledgment

authorization.description: Ed25519-signed policy decision envelope; hashes and identifiers only
authorization.title: Authorization

trusted_keys.description: Out-of-band pinned policy and executor Ed25519 public keys; never private keys
trusted_keys.title: Trusted Keys
